Method of Attack: Deploy malicious modules on compromised computers using Microsoft Graph API calls
Command and control module using attacker’s Microsoft OneDrive account to execute commands and retrieve results
Delivered via spear phishing emails with malicious documents (PowerPoint in 2020) that drop files with two payloads
Modified version disguised as PNG image file to download more modules and establish backdoor channel
Impacted Systems: Compromised computers using Microsoft Graph API
Organizations in maritime, health, higher education, and regional government sectors
Attack Vector: Spear phishing emails delivering malicious documents
Use of Azure Active Directory applications for command and control
Use of legitimate Microsoft cloud services (OneDrive, Azure AD) to evade detection
